summary: The coordinate identifications follow from the accepted normalization. The proof then uses exact measurable partitions of K, valid cap inclusions, the three strict low-row bounds, and correct algebra to obtain both lobe inequalities. Nonnegativity of the endpoint cap areas together with s>1-h^2 gives the strict 1/9 bounds. Open and closed cutting-line conventions cause no loss because affine lines have planar area zero, and no positive-cell assumption is used.
